propositions: Existing stores lack `.bridge_state/projects.json` and `bridge_project` on tickets, causing every ticket to read as absent-project with no legacy default fallback.
The migration must seed the project mapping once via idempotent ensure units registered in the idempotent registry, converging all stores at init/re-init/fsck/MCP-boot without operator action.
Ensure unit 1 seeds the mapping when absent, writing `.bridge_state/projects.json` with `legacy_default` from `Backend.project` and zero commits if already converged.
Ensure unit 2 conditionally stamps `multi-project-bridge` in `required_capabilities` only when the mapping contains more than one project (convergence backstop for divergence).
The migration must write zero ticket events; sweeping a no-mapping store produces no new event files.
A one-project mapping never receives the `multi-project-bridge` stamp and remains compatible with older binaries.
